Source: smg-project/llm-multimodal, f0985ef65967615db2c79279aa07818499301bfd (Apache-2.0; LICENSE included). The old frontend depends on its 1.7.1 processor and wire interfaces. The local backport adds an opt-in GLM source-index frame sampler inside the existing URL/bytes/size-limited connector and carries source timestamps with the one decoded RGB buffer. Other model families retain the default connector. Production library, build inputs and upstream benchmarks are included; the vLLM frontend owns GLM regression tests.
